# PR #4558: Patch: the AI's quality gates are held to win rates measured on today's AI, so the daily run notices when it gets weaker

Closes #4513

## What changed and why

The AI's quality gates in [[§9.9]](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/spec/09-architecture.md#L171) derive their pass thresholds (`gate_needed`) from measured win rates on tuning deals ([`AI_GATE.measured_rate`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/ai/src/gate.rs#L119-L123)). Prior to this change, those rates remained at the TypeScript AI's historical figures from September 2026 (94.5% vs random, 68.0% vs greedy, 91.3% Hard vs Easy), meaning an AI that had regressed to 60% against greedy still cleared the daily full run 77% of the time (needing only 28 of 50 wins). Furthermore, no tool existed to re-measure these baselines on fresh deals without contaminating the fixed `gate:v3` gate series.

This patch adds `cargo jackioh gate --measure [--games N]`, performs the measurement on fresh tuning deals, records ruling [R4513000](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/spec/rulings/R4513000.md), and raises the measured rates and gate floors:

1. **Seed series parameterization in `crates/ai`:**
   - Parameterized [`run_games`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/ai/src/gate.rs#L311) with `series: &str`.
   - Exported [`run_tuning_gate_games`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/ai/src/gate.rs#L301), which plays on [`AI_TUNING_SERIES`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/ai/src/gate.rs#L135) (`"tune"`: `tune:<matchup>:<n>`).
   - Exported [`gate_needed_with_rate`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/ai/src/gate.rs#L175) to allow arbitrary rate projections without mutating constants.

2. **Measurement CLI in `crates/tools`:**
   - Added `--measure` and updated `--games <N>` (defaulting to [`DEFAULT_MEASURE_GAMES`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/tools/src/gate.rs#L44) = 300) in [`Args`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/tools/src/gate.rs#L62-L73).
   - Refactored [`check_report`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/tools/src/gate.rs#L768) into [`check_report_series`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/tools/src/gate.rs#L734) so tuning seeds are validated properly against `AI_TUNING_SERIES`.
   - Implemented [`measure_matchups`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/tools/src/gate.rs#L1213), which computes 95% Wilson intervals via [`wilson_interval`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/tools/src/gate.rs#L1227), reports projected win requirements at 20, 50, and 100 games, and verifies clean execution (B31; exits 1 only on unclean games without judging win floors).
   - Documented the command in [`crates/tools/README.md`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/tools/README.md#L33) and [`crates/ai/README.md`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/ai/README.md#L649).

3. **Fresh tuning deal measurement:**
   - Per maintainer @MaxGoetzmann's decision on Option 1 (measuring 50 games per matchup in this PR due to runner 2-vCPU execution time limits), measured 50 games per matchup at `AI_GATE_BUDGET`:
     - `ai-vs-random`: 50 wins and 0 turn-cap draws of 50; rate: 1.000 (95% Wilson: [0.929, 1.000]); needed: 20 -> 19, 50 -> 48, 100 -> 95 (350.9s)
     - `ai-vs-greedy`: 46 wins and 0 turn-cap draws of 50; rate: 0.920 (95% Wilson: [0.812, 0.968]); needed: 20 -> 14, 50 -> 35, 100 -> 70 (429.7s)
     - `hard-vs-easy`: 47 wins and 0 turn-cap draws of 50; rate: 0.940 (95% Wilson: [0.838, 0.979]); needed: 20 -> 15, 50 -> 38, 100 -> 75 (876.3s)
     - Wall time: 1656.9s (27.6 minutes). Every game was clean (B31): 0 rejected, 0 thrown, 0 fallbacks, 0 sim panics, 0 replay errors, replay hashes matched.

   - All three measured rates were higher than today's baseline; none was lower:
     - `ai_vs_random`: 1.0 (raised from 0.945)
     - `ai_vs_greedy`: 0.92 (raised from 0.68)
     - `hard_vs_easy`: 0.94 (raised from 0.913)
   - Recorded the findings in [spec/rulings/R4513000.md](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/spec/rulings/R4513000.md) and [spec/pending/4513.md](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/spec/pending/4513.md).
   - Updated [`AI_GATE.measured_rate`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/crates/ai/src/gate.rs#L119-L124) and [`docs/polish/3-ai.md`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/docs/polish/3-ai.md#L914).
   - Updated [[§9.9]](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4513/spec/09-architecture.md#L171) to reflect the new measurement, note that greedy now clears the brief's 70%, and update floor requirements (random: 95/100 and 19/20; greedy: 35/50 and 14/20; Hard vs Easy: 38/50 and 15/20).

# #4513: Patch: the AI's quality gates are held to win rates measured on today's AI, so the daily run notices when it gets weaker
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Every day an automatic check plays the computer opponent against two simple opponents, and its Hard level against its Easy level, and fails if it wins too few games. How many wins count as too few is worked out from how often the AI was once measured to win. That measurement was taken in September, on an earlier version of the AI, and nobody has taken it again since. The spot checks that AI changes report suggest today's AI beats the simple 'greedy' opponent far more often than it did then, so the bar sits so low that the AI could lose a large part of its strength and the daily check would still pass. Once this is built there is a command that takes the measurement again on fresh deals, it is taken once, and the bar moves up to match. The maintainer finds out when an AI change makes the opponent weaker; players notice nothing directly.

## Why
